page.overview:
Who is Raspberry Ant?

The Raspberry Ant is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"Kersplat! If you're an ant carrying food to the offering stone for the grasshoppers, maybe it's refreshing to have a plump raspberry dropped on you by a seed collector ant. At least you'll get some juice to go."
